notes: Server-cluster downloader (python -m server_cluster.downloader): the resident FastAPI API entry over the downloads.* area's cmds — POST /jobs/run (detached spawn of any downloads.* module, tag-deduped), /jobs/status + /jobs/result (service-log tail), /jobs/{tag}/stop, and the resident stream-poller control GET /processes + POST /processes/{service}/start|stop|restart.
